goal: Point at things and places: 这个, 那个, 这里, 那里.

blocks.text: 这 (zhè) is *this*, 那 (nà) is *that*. On their own they start a sentence: 这是… *This is…*, 那是… *That is…*

blocks.h: 这个, 那个: this one, that one

blocks.text: Before a noun, or for *this one*, add 个 (ge): 这个人 *this person*, 那个东西 *that thing*. 个 is a measure word (G10). In speech you'll often hear zhèige and nèige.

wrong: After a verb, say 那个: 我要那个.

blocks.h: 这些, 那些: these, those
这里, 那里: here, there

ex: There are a lot of people there.

blocks.tip: 这 (zhè) has the tongue curled back for zh (P05), 那 (nà) the tongue tip behind the teeth for n. Both are 4th tones. Don't mix up 那 with 哪 (nǎ, *which*, G10): same sound, but a 3rd tone.

exercises.explain: After a verb, *this one* is 这个.

order: There are a lot of people there.
